CEC Recreations · Vanguard

32 combat enhancement cards, recreated from the recovered art panels (OneDrive archive, upscaled 3×) and the exact printed card text from Warrenborn's archived card pages. Frame, typography and point-badge placement are typeset in the spirit of the 2.0 card design — no complete card scans were ever archived anywhere. Rarity is not shown: it was not captured in the recovery.

23 pts
Repair
Light
Attaches to Attack
Provides Square Repair SE. This gear may be used with this unit's other non-Repair attack special equipment. This unit gains the wrench attack symbol in addition to the crosshairs attack symbol.
SE RULE — Repair (AoD SEC sheet)
Repair (optional) This unit may be given close combat orders, regardless of its type. Make a close combat attack targeting a friendly figure; neither this unit nor the target may be in base contact with an opposing figure. Ignore all non–heat effect close combat modifiers. If the attack succeeds, repair the target of damage equal to either this unit’s damage value or the result of one six-sided die. If this unit has the [glyph] attack symbol, it can repair only figures with the [glyph] speed mode. If this unit has the [glyph] attack symbol, it can repair all figures except those with the [glyph] speed mode. If this unit has the [glyph] attack symbol, it can repair any figure.
Bracketed words stand in for the printed color range-type, speed-mode or attack-symbol glyphs on the SEC sheet.

14 pts
Homing Beacon (Single-Use)
Light
Attaches to Ballistic
Provides Circle Homing Beacon SE.
SE RULE — Homing Beacon (AoD SEC sheet)
Homing Beacon (optional) Give this unit a ranged combat order targeting a single opposing vehicle or ’Mech; it gets +2 to its attack value for this attack. If the attack succeeds, until the end of your turn any line of fire for a ranged combat attack using the [glyph] range type drawn to the target is clear, and the target ignores hindering terrain when it is the target of ranged combat attacks using the [glyph] range type.
Bracketed words stand in for the printed color range-type, speed-mode or attack-symbol glyphs on the SEC sheet.

27 pts
TSEMP
Light
Attaches to Energy
Provides Square TSEMP SE.
SE RULE — TSEMP (AoD SEC sheet)
TSEMP (Tight-Stream Electromagnetic Pulse) (optional) Give this unit a ranged combat order targeting a single opposing figure with zero or one order token. If the attack succeeds, and the target is not shutdown, give the target an order token after resolving the attack. If a ’Mech is given a second order token in this way, it shuts down; remove both tokens at the beginning of the controlling player’s next turn. If the target is at cruising level, it changes to NOE level; do not move it. If it cannot occupy the terrain at its NOE position, eliminate it.

26 pts
Evade (Single Use)
Heavy
Attaches to Speed
Provides Circle Evade SE. This gear may be used with this unit's other non-Evade speed special equipment. It is not ignored when this unit gains Salvage.
SE RULE — Salvage (AoD SEC sheet)
Salvage (optional) If this unit is an infantry or a vehicle, it may be given only move orders and may not be pushed. If this unit is a ’Mech, it may be given only move or vent orders and may not make a death from above special attack.
SE RULE — Evade (AoD SEC sheet)
Evade (optional) This unit gets +2 to its defense value against ranged combat attacks. It fails to break away only on a result of 1. If this unit is a ’Mech, it does not gain 1 heat when it uses the run option.

16 pts
Coolant Pod
Assault
Attaches to Attack
This gear may be used with this unit's other non-Coolant Pod attack special equipment. When this unit is dealt damage from a ranged combat attack, roll one six-sided die after the attack resolves. On a result of 1, this gear is eliminated, and no player receives victory points for its elimination. In addition, deal 2 pushing damage to this unit. (optional) When this unit resolves an order, it does not gain heat. In addition, turn its heat dial to the starting position; do not make any heat effect rolls. Then eliminate this gear.
